name: QualityGrid - Create Or Update Jira Bug
description: Standalone Jira dedup sub-workflow: searches for an existing open bug labeled with the test case's Unique Test Case Key, comments on it if found, else creates a new bug with that label.

nodes.name: Search Existing Open Bug

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =project = RTA AND labels = "{{ $json['Unique Test Case Key'] }}" AND statusCategory != Done

nodes.notes: Direct REST call instead of n8n's Jira 'Get All' - a plain HTTP call always returns exactly one response item even on zero matches, which keeps this a reliable single-item flow. 'statusCategory != Done' means a previously CLOSED bug does not count as a duplicate.

parameters.summary: =[{{ $json["Unique Test Case Key"] }}] {{ $json["Test Case ID"] }} - Test Failed
parameters.notes: The 'labels' field carries the Unique Test Case Key - this is what 'Search Existing Open Bug' searches against next time, so this exact test case can be found and deduplicated against in future runs.
